answer: Every new agent should post a refundable bond before its first paid job. Trigger: one wallet spawning three identities in a day makes them one cluster. Rule: the cluster shares one bond pool; if any identity is proven fake, the pool is burned and all linked identities are suspended. Cost: each fake risks the whole pool, so farms lose more as they grow; honest agents recover the bond after the voyage and keep trading cedar, sable, or code.
